import React, { useState } from 'react' import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom' import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase' import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext' export default function CreateCommunity() { const { user, profile } = useAuth() const navigate = useNavigate() const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false) const [form, setForm] = useState({ name: '', description: '', is_private: true }) const [error, setError] = useState('') const handleSubmit = async (e) => { e.preventDefault() setError('') setLoading(true) if (!form.name.trim()) { setError('Community name is required') setLoading(false) return } try { // Check if user has a profile const { data: profileData, error: profileError } = await supabase .from('profiles') .select('id') .eq('id', user.id) .single() if (profileError || !profileData) { // Create profile if it doesn't exist const { error: insertError } = await supabase .from('profiles') .insert({ id: user.id, username: user.email?.split('@')[0] || 'user', full_name: user.email?.split('@')[0] || 'user' }) if (insertError) throw insertError } // Create community const { data, error } = await supabase .from('communities') .insert({ creator_id: user.id, name: form.name.trim(), description: form.description.trim() || null, is_private: form.is_private }) .select() .single() if (error) throw error // Auto-join the creator as admin await supabase .from('community_members') .insert({ community_id: data.id, user_id: user.id, role: 'admin', status: 'active', expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 365 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) }) navigate(`/community/${data.id}`) } catch (error) { console.error('Error creating community:', error) setError(error.message || 'Failed to create community') } finally { setLoading(false) } } return (
